entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: Out of my distress I called upon  Jehovah:  Jehovah answered me [and set me] in a large place.

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They compassed me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This is  Jehovah's doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: Blessed be he that  cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.
